label: news
title: The league selection period for the Champions Meeting: Sagittarius Cup has begun!
message:
At 10:00 p.m., Oct 10, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Sagittarius Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Sagittarius Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 10–9:59 p.m., Oct 16, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 7–9:59 p.m., Oct 14, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Oct 10, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Oct 12, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Oct 14, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Oct 10–9:59 p.m., Oct 12, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Oct 12–9:59 p.m., Oct 14, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 14–9:59 a.m., Oct 15, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Oct 15–9:59 p.m., Oct 15, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 15–9:59 p.m., Oct 16, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Nakayama / Turf / 2,500m (Long) / Right-Handed / Inner / Winter / Cloudy / Good

 The following skills will not activate in this Sagittarius Cup:
 • Night Races ◎
 • Night Races ○
 • Night Races ×
 • Sharp Turns ◎
 • Sharp Turns ○
 • Sharp Turns ×
 • Collaborative Graded Races ◎
 • Collaborative Graded Races ○
 • Collaborative Graded Races ×

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Sagittarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Sagittarius Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 It is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 The ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Sagittarius Cup Platinum
 • Sagittarius Cup Gold
 • Sagittarius Cup Silver
 • Sagittarius Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Sagittarius Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to Champions Meeting under Races in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the Menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

label: news
title: The event Aim for the Stars! Dream Team is here!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Sep 27, 2026 (UTC), an Aim for the Stars! Dream Team event has begun!

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 27–9:59 p.m., Oct 4, 2026 (UTC)

 Reward Collection Period

 10:00 p.m., Oct 4–9:59 p.m., Oct 7, 2026 (UTC)

 Event Overview

 In Aim for the Stars! Dream Team events, your goal is to build the ultimate team of seven racers, including one of your own Veteran Umamusume and an additional six Umamusume scouted over the course of the event.
 Do your best to defeat the teams of other trainers from around the world, and for each matchup you win, you'll have the opportunity to scout a racer from the opposing team!

 Building a Team

 The team you will use to enter Scout Races consists of seven racers: one captain and six regular members.
 The captain can be selected freely from your own Veteran Umamusume.
 The regular members can be replaced when you are given the opportunity to scout racers during the event.

 Scout Races

 You can enter Scout Races using the team you have built.
 In each Scout Race, you will face the team of another trainer from around the world.
 All seven members of your team will face all seven members of the opponent's team in the same race.
 Based on the results of the race, you can earn rewards and Scout Points.

 Scout Race Tickets

 Each Scout Race costs one Scout Race Ticket to enter.
 Your Scout Race Tickets will replenish up to a maximum of five at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) on each day of the event.
 You can also obtain Scout Race Tickets from the event's daily missions, and up to five additional tickets can be replenished each day by using carats, Carrot Jelly items, or Carrot Jelly Mini items.
 (You can only replenish Scout Race Tickets using carats or items after consuming all Scout Race Tickets you currently possess.)

 Race Conditions

 Racecourse: Tokyo, Nakayama, Kyoto, Morioka
 Season: Fall
 Race conditions other than the season are variable and change every three races entered.

 Scout Time

 Winning a Scout Race triggers a Scout Time opportunity.
 During Scout Time, you can consume Scout Points to replace one of your current team members with a racer from the team of the opponent you just faced.

 Team History

 Umamusume Records

 Each time you win a Scout Race, all racers in the winning team will be added to your Umamusume Records roster.
 Each racer in your Umamusume Records grants a bonus to all of your team members' attributes in subsequent Scout Races.

 Scout Point Bonus

 When you earn Scout Points, a bonus will be applied based on the number of racers in your Umamusume Records.

 Team Skills

 You can earn team skills by winning Scout Races with certain specific combinations of racers in your team.
 Once obtained, team skills can be used by all of your team members during Scout Races.

 Event Rewards

 Rating Rewards

 You can earn rewards for each new Team Rank you achieve by increasing your team's rating.
 (Rewards are added directly to your totals.)
 [Notable Rewards]
 • Carats
 • Rainbow Crystal Shard
 • Gold Crystal Shard
 • Trainee Scout Ticket
 • Support Card Scout Ticket

 Event Missions

 You can also obtain rewards by completing the event's daily missions and special missions.
 [Notable Rewards]
 • Carats
 • Rainbow Crystal Shard
 • Gold Crystal Shard

 Changes from the Previous Aim for the Stars! Dream Team Event

 1. A new Scout Rankings feature has been added.
 This feature allows you to view the top 100 Veteran Umamusume that have been scouted most frequently during the event period.
 These rankings are based on data gathered from all trainers around the world.
   • Scout Rankings are updated daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
   • On the first day of the event, data is still being tallied, so no rankings are available to view.
   • Umamusume featured in the rankings will continue to be displayed even if the original Veteran Umamusume is transferred.
   • If multiple Umamusume are scouted an equal number of times, they will be displayed with the same ranking, and subsequent rankings will be offset accordingly.
   • Only Veteran Umamusume in the Scout Ranking will have their scout totals displayed.
 2. On the Change Captain screen and the confirmation dialog before starting a race, it is now possible to check whether Umamusume have been added to your Records.
 3. On the Change Captain screen and the Scout Time screen, it is now possible to check whether you have acquired Team Skills.
 4. A new Change Captain button has been added to the main event screen.
 5. When choosing an opponent, it is now possible to check how many Scout Points each opponent will yield if defeated.
 6. Umamusume filter options have been adjusted.
 7. In Scout Races, opponent racers' attributes will now be reduced based on the number of times you have retried.
 8. The Team Rank cap has been increased to SS, and rewards for reaching Team Ranks have been adjusted accordingly.
 9. The Record Bonus in Team History has been adjusted.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on the event, tap the Help icon on the top right of the event screen.
 2. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
 3. Scout Points earned in this event cannot be carried over to future events.
 4. Team members and Team History will be removed at the end of the event. They cannot be carried over to future events.
 5. If you start a race that ends after the conclusion of the event period, you may not be able to finish.
 6. If Scout Time is active when the event period ends, you may not be able to complete scouting.
 7. If a race is still unfinished when the reward collection period ends, you will not receive rewards.
 8. If a Scout Time session is still unfinished when the reward collection period ends, you will not receive rewards.
 9. If you have unclaimed rewards for an event mission when that mission is reset, they will be sent to your Presents the next time you log in. Scout Race Tickets will be added directly to your totals.

title: Transfer Requests now available!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Sep 24, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 24–9:59 p.m., Sep 28, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Once a Veteran Umamusume has been transferred, it cannot be recovered.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater the rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the contents and rank of the request.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The Transfer Request schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

label: news
title: The race event Champions Meeting: Scorpio Cup is here!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Sep 19, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Scorpio Cup has begun!
 Champions Meeting: Scorpio Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 19–9:59 p.m., Sep 25, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 15–9:59 p.m., Sep 23, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Sep 19, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Sep 21, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Sep 23, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Sep 19–9:59 p.m., Sep 21, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Sep 21–9:59 p.m., Sep 23, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 23–9:59 a.m., Sep 24, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Sep 24–9:59 p.m., Sep 24, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 24–9:59 p.m., Sep 25, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Kyoto / Turf / 2,200m (Medium) / Right-Handed / Outer / Autumn / Sunny / Firm

 The following skills will not activate during this Scorpio Cup.
 • Night Races ◎
 • Night Races ○
 • Night Races ×
 • Sharp Turns ◎
 • Sharp Turns ○
 • Sharp Turns ×
 • Collaborative Graded Races ◎
 • Collaborative Graded Races ○
 • Collaborative Graded Races ×

 Changes from the Libra Cup

 • The event banner UI on the Home screen has been improved.
 • The position of the event banner has been moved to the top-right of the Home screen.
 • The display size of participating Veteran Umamusume on certain event screens has been adjusted.
 • After viewing the Winning Concert for the Champions Meeting once, the Winning Concert will only automatically play after a first-place finish.
 Note: If you finish in a place lower than first in the final round, you can view the Winning Concert by selecting "To Concert" from within Champions Meeting.

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Scorpio Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Scorpio Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 It is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 The ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 • The event banner UI on the Home screen has been improved.

 Note: If you finish in a place lower than first in the final round, you can view the Winning Concert by selecting "To Concert" from within Champions Meeting.

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Scorpio Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Scorpio Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 It is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 The ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.

label: news
title: Transfer Requests now available!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Sep 1, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 1 - 9:59 p.m., Sep 5, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Once a Veteran Umamusume has been transferred, it cannot be recovered.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only select Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions for transfer.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

 Your rewards will differ depending on the contents and rank of the request.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

label: news
title: Let's Go! Uma Outing now available!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Sep 1, 2026 (UTC), a Let's Go! Uma Outing event is underway!

 During this event, you can go on Outings with your trainees up to twice a day!
 Going on Outings will increase your trainee's Bond, and you can acquire a variety of helpful rewards.

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Sep 1 - 2:59 p.m., Sep 10, 2026 (UTC)

 How to Go on Outings

 1. During the event availability period, select the Let's Go! Uma Outing button from the top left corner of the home screen.
 2. Select the trainee you want to go on an Outing with from the event screen and press "OK."
 3. Select your Outing Destination from the selection screen and press "OK."
 4. Select the Outing Reward you want from the selection screen and press "OK."
 5. Press "OK" on the confirmation screen.
 6. Your Outing Episode will play, your trainee's Bond will increase, and you will acquire your Outing Reward.

 Outing Gauge

 You can go on Outings by filling the Outing Gauge to its max.
 The Outing Gauge is filled once per day by logging in. After going on an Outing, it can be filled an additional time afterwards by playing Career Mode, Team Trials, Daily Races, and Daily Legend Races.
 (The Outing Gauge cannot be filled past its cap.)

 Important Information

 1. Only acquired Trainee Umamusume are eligible as partners for Outings.
 2. The login bonus for Outings and possible times you can go on an Outing reset at 3:00 p.m. (UTC) each day.
 3. Unlocked Outing Episodes can be viewed by selecting the "Let's Go! Uma Outing" icon at the top left of the home screen and holding down the Umamusume's icon on the pop-up that displays after.
 (Outing Episodes can only be viewed during the event's availability period.)
 4. Outing Episodes unlocked during this event will become locked again during the next event.
 5. Once you have acquired all the rewards from an Outing Destination, you will be unable to acquire any more and only be able acquire Bond.
 6. You will be able to earn Bond from Outings with Trainee Umamusume who have reached their max Bond Level up to a maximum of 5,000 past the cap.
 7. If an Outing hasn't been finished when the event ends, the Bond of the Trainee Umamusume you were on an Outing with will increase and your selected rewards will be sent to your Presents the next time you log in.
 (You will be unable to view the Outing Episode of the Trainee Umamusume whose Outing you did not finish.)
 (You must log in within 180 days of the event ending to receive rewards.)
 (Rewards will expire 30 days after they're sent to your Presents.)
 8. The Uma Outing schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Libra Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Libra Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 It is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 The ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Libra Cup Platinum
 • Libra Cup Gold
 • Libra Cup Silver
 • Libra Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Libra Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to Champions Meeting under Races in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.

 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

message:

 The Spotlight Pretty Derby Scout features a new Trainee Umamusume.
 The Spotlight Support Card Scout features a selection of spotlighted Support Cards of the Speed and Wit types.
 During the Spotlight period, scout rates for spotlighted Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are increased!

 In addition, if you obtain a spotlighted 3★ Trainee Umamusume, you will receive more of her Star Pieces than usual as a bonus.
 During the availability period, you can earn bonuses as many times as you acquire the spotlighted 3★ Trainee Umamusume, including when you do so by using Trainee Exchange Points.

label: news
title: Transfer Requests now available!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 12 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 16, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Please be aware that once a Veteran Umamusume has been transferred, it cannot be recovered.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the contents and rank of the request.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

 Event Overview

 The Trainer Aptitude Test is an event where trainers can test their prowess in eligible Career scenarios and aim to achieve a high score.
 Complete Careers to earn rewards based on your scores, test rating, and mission completion!

 Event-Eligible Career Scenarios

 Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert

 How to Participate

 When selecting an eligible Career scenario, you can choose "Take on a Trainer Aptitude Test" to participate.

 Test Contents

 1. Sprint Test
 2. Mile Test
 3. Medium Test
 4. Long Test
 5. Dirt Test
 6. Extra Test
 7. Free Test

 At the start of the event, you can challenge tests 1-5.
 In each attempt, you will receive a test result of "A," B," or "C."

 "Extra Test" will be unlocked once you have received a test result of at least "C" on tests 1-5.
 "Free Test" will be unlocked once you have received a test result of at least "C" on "Extra Test".

 Aim for a result of "A" to earn a unique title exclusive to this event!

 By obtaining strong test results and completing event missions, you can earn Test Coins and other rewards!

 Test Coins

 Test Coins are an item that can be obtained by taking part in this event.

 The top 100 Leading Umamusume are updated every day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 Only the Veteran Umamusume with which you achieved the highest score during the event period is eligible to appear in this ranking.
 Note: On the first day of the event, scores are still being tallied, so no rankings are available to view.

 From 4:00 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC), Leading Umamusume ranked in the top 30 can be borrowed as legacies during the event availability period.
 There is no limit to how many times these legacies can be borrowed, but they are only available when selecting to take on the Trainer Aptitude Test in an eligible Career scenario.

 When selecting a Legacy Umamusume under the Event tab in a Career, a message reading "Tallying" may appear. If it does, please allow some time to pass before revisiting the Career screen.

 4. The amount of coins you can acquire in tests has been adjusted.
 5. The number of Test Coins required to obtain some items has been adjusted in the Test Coins Exchange.
 6. The amount of monies necessary to rent Leading Umamusume has been changed to 3,000 across the board.
 7. All event screen UI has been adjusted.

 1. For more information on the event, tap the Help icon on the top left of the event's home screen.

 3. As it can take time for Leading Umamusume rankings to update, the previous day's rankings may still be displayed in some cases.

label: news
title: The race event Champions Meeting: Virgo Cup is here!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Aug 8, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Virgo Cup has begun!

 Champions Meeting: Virgo Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 8 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 14, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 5 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Aug 8, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Aug 10, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Aug 8 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 10, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Aug 10 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 12, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 12 - 9:59 a.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Aug 13 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 13, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Aug 13 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 14, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Oi / Dirt / 2,000m (Medium) / Right-Handed / Fall / Sunny / Good

 The following skills will activate during this Virgo Cup.
 • Collaborative Graded Races ◎
 • Collaborative Graded Races ○
 • Collaborative Graded Races ×

 The following skills will not activate during this Virgo Cup.
 • Night Races ◎
 • Night Races ○
 • Night Races ×
 • Sharp Turns ◎
 • Sharp Turns ○
 • Sharp Turns ×

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Virgo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Virgo Cup Platinum
 • Virgo Cup Gold
 • Virgo Cup Silver
 • Virgo Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Virgo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Details

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Virgo Cup Platinum
 • Virgo Cup Gold
 • Virgo Cup Silver
 • Virgo Cup Bronze

 If you re-obtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Virgo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

label: news
title: The new Career scenario "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert" is here!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), the new Career scenario "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert" has been added to the game!
 In this new scenario, you can train your trainees using a different system than all previous Career scenarios.
 To get started with the new scenario, simply select Career from the Home screen, then select "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert"!

 "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert" Story Outline

 Why do Umamusume sing for their fans? An event planner suggests rekindling the Grand Concert—inspiring the runners to find just what performances mean to them!
 Check out the newest Career scenario, featuring new characters and new systems!
 Revive the Grand Concert, a dream stage that all Umamusume can stand on!

 Scenario Systems

 Here's a sneak peek of the new systems you'll encounter in the "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert" scenario!

 Grand Concert

 In this new Career scenario, your goal is to revive the Grand Concert.
 Four Promo Concerts and one Grand Concert are held, making for a total of five concerts.
 Work towards making things a great success by making each concert a spectacle!

 Concerts are held biannually starting from the second half of December during your trainee's junior year.
 Prepare for concerts during the period leading up to them and make them unforgettable!

 Performance and Lessons

 In this new Career scenario, you acquire Performance through activities like training and Career events.
 There are five types of Performance: Dance, Passion, Vocals, Visuals, and Composure.
 By spending Performance in lessons, you can acquire new songs and concert techniques.
 Songs and concert techniques don't just make concerts more exciting; they also have various effects, such as increasing your parameters, recovering energy, and boosting training effects.

 Live Performance Expectations

 By holding lessons and acquiring new songs as you work towards your next concert, your Live Performance Expectations will increase.
 When it reaches its max, your next concert will be a Great Success.
 Make sure to acquire plenty of songs and make your concert a Great Success!

 Important Information

 1. For more information on the new Career scenario, please refer to Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert under Career in Help.
2. The details of Career scenarios are subject to change without notice.

message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), the Daily Free 10x Scout event has begun!

 Each day you log in during this event, you will be able to perform a 10x scout on one of the currently available Scouts, up to a maximum of 10 times.
 Each free 10x scout becomes available every day at 3:00 p.m. (UTC).
 The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible Scout changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Additionally, trainers will be able to use the Free Scout Stock function once during this event.

 Daily Free 10x Scout Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 - 2:59 p.m., Aug 1, 2026 (UTC)

 Daily Free 10x Scout Event Eligible Scout Availability Period

 • New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout
 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 27, 2026 (UTC)

 • Spotlight Support Card Scout
 10:00 p.m., Jul 27 - 2:59 p.m., Aug 1, 2026 (UTC)

 About Free Scout Stock

 Free Scout Stock is a function that allows trainers to use the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event when logging in for the first time after it has begun.

 When Free Scout Stock is Applicable

 Free Scout Stock is applicable if:
 • If it is your first time logging in during the event
 Trainers can use all the free 10x scouts accumulated each day throughout the event up to that point.

 Example: If you do not log in between 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 and 9:59 p.m., Jul 27 (UTC), and log in for the first time at 10:00 p.m., Jul 27 (UTC), you can use 6 free 10x scouts on the Spotlight Support Card Scout.

 Free Scout Stock is not applicable if:
 • If you do not log in during the event; if you log in after the event has ended

 • If it is not your first time logging in during the event

 Important Information Regarding Free Scout Stock

 1. Free Scout Stock is only applicable once during the event.
 2. Free Scout Stock is applied after selecting "TAP TO START" on the title screen.
 Note: If the period during which Free Scout Stock can be used has already ended, you will be unable to use your accumulated free 10x scouts.
 3. Free Scout Stock for this event cannot be used after it has ended or in any future events. Additionally, the Free Scout Stock for any given day expires at 2:59 p.m. (UTC), even if the event has not ended.

 Important Information Regarding the Event

 1. Each free 10x scout becomes available at 3:00 p.m. (UTC). If you have not used the previous day's free scout at this time, it will be lost and cannot be carried over.
   2. The daily free 10x scout is available once per day. If the eligible Scout changes after using your daily free 10x scout, then you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for it until the next time it resets.
 Example: If you log in at 4:00 p.m., Jul 27 (UTC), use your free 10x scout on the New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout, and the eligible Scout changes to the Spotlight Support Card Scout at 10:00 p.m. (UTC), you will be unable to use a free 10x scout for the new Spotlight Support Card Scout.
 3. If you have any free scouts remaining when this event ends, they will be lost. It is not possible to carry over free scouts to future events.
 4. There is no difference in scout rates between free scouts from this event and scouts performed on the same Scout using carats.
 5. To check the specific rates at which Support Cards appear from the New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout and Spotlight Support Card Scout, tap Details on the Scout screen and select the Rates tab.
 6. Scouting while your scouts are being restored may cause an error.
 7. The availability period and event contents are subject to change without notice.

As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), a New Career Scenario Celebration Pretty Derby Scout and New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout have begun!

 The New Career Scenario Celebration Pretty Derby Scout features a new Trainee Umamusume.
 The New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout features new Support Cards, including some of the Pal type.

 The Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards debuting in these Scouts are featured as Scenario Link characters in the Career Scenario "Brighter Together! Our Grand Concert."

 During the Spotlight period, scout rates for spotlighted Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are increased!

 In addition, if you obtain a spotlighted 3★ Trainee Umamusume, you will receive more of her Star Pieces than usual as a bonus.
 During the availability period, you can earn bonuses as many times as you acquire the spotlighted 3★ Trainee Umamusume, including when you do so by using Trainee Exchange Points.
 The spotlighted Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards are listed below.
 

 New Career Scenario Celebration Scout Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 10, 2026 (UTC)

 Trainee Umamusume

 ■ Debut Trainee Umamusume (Spotlight)
 ★★★ [Twilight Triumph] Smart Falcon

 ■ Spotlight Trainee Umamusume
 ★★★ [Twilight Triumph] Smart Falcon
 Scout Bonus:
 [Twilight Triumph] Smart Falcon Star Piece × 90
 

 Support Cards

 ■ Debut Support Cards (Spotlight)
 • SSR [From the Ground Up] Light Hello
 • SSR [Q≠0] Agnes Tachyon
 • R [Event Producer] Light Hello

 Important Information

 1. To check the specific rates at which Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards appear from the New Career Scenario Celebration Pretty Derby Scout and New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout, tap Details on the Scout screen and select the Scout Rates tab.
 2. Support Cards will not appear in the New Career Scenario Celebration Pretty Derby Scout.
 3. Trainee Umamusume will not appear in the New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout.
 4. Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points from these New Career Scenario Celebration Scouts cannot be carried over to future Scouts or other Scouts currently in progress.
 5. Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points not utilized during the New Career Scenario Celebration Scout availability period will automatically be converted into Clovers.
 6. The New Career Scenario Celebration Pretty Derby Scout and New Career Scenario Celebration Support Card Scout schedules and contents are subject to change without notice.
 7. What you can exchange Trainee Exchange Points and Support Card Exchange Points for differs depending on the Scout.
 8. Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards that you can exchange Exchange Points for may become available again in the future.
 9. Trainee Umamusume with the same name cannot be on the same team, nor can they be selected as Legacy Umamusume at the same time in Career mode.
 10. The abilities and skills of the Umamusume appearing in this New Career Scenario Celebration Pretty Derby Scout may differ from those of the same character in Career scenarios and Career Events.
 11. For details on the Spotlight Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards, select the Featured Trainees or Featured Cards button at the top-right of each Scout screen.
 12. When scouting a Spotlight 2★ Trainee Umamusume, the number of Star Pieces acquired will remain the normal amount.

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek

 To celebrate the new arrival of [Twilight Triumph] Smart Falcon, episodes 1 through 4 of her Umamusume Story will be fully unlocked for a limited time!
 During the sneak peek period, you can watch the story episodes even without fulfilling their unlock conditions!

 Umamusume Story Sneak Peek Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 22 - 9:59 p.m., Aug 10, 2026 (UTC)

 Applicable Umamusume

 • Smart Falcon

 Important Information

 1. During the sneak peek period, even if you have not obtained the applicable Umamusume, you can still watch episodes 1 through 4 of their Umamusume Stories!
 2. If you do watch episodes 1 through 4 of an applicable Umamusume's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, and Umamusume Archive experience.
 3. If you do not watch episodes 1 through 4 of an applicable Umamusume's Umamusume Story during the sneak peek period, you will not obtain first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, or Umamusume Archive experience.
 4. After the sneak peek period has ended, any unwatched Umamusume Stories will once again become locked.
 5. Umamusume Stories can be viewed after the tutorial is completed.

label: news
title: Introducing the Independent Training Feature
message:
As of 8:00 a.m., Jul 22, 2026 (UTC), the Independent Training function has been added to the game and can be used in all Career Scenarios!


■ About Independent Training
 Independent Training is a function that automatically advances a Career, completing it about 50 minutes after it starts.
 The Independent Training timer will progress even if you close the application.
 Additionally, content such as Umamusume Stories and races is playable by returning to the Home screen.
 (Unlike normal Career playthroughs, Independent Training has its own unique way of handling training and events that occur during the Career.)

 ■ Starting Independent Training
 Starting Independent Training remains the same as a normal Career up through editing your Support Card deck. During the Final Confirmation screen, Independent Training can be started by selecting the Independent Training tab and starting the playthrough.

 ■ Completing Independent Training
 When the remaining time reaches 0:00:00, you will be taken to the Complete Career screen, and your Independent Training log will display.
 The Independent Training log can be used to confirm info such as your Career results, score, obtained skill hints, and Inspiration records.
 After the Independent Training log is displayed, the rest of the Career completion process is the same as a normal Career.
 Points from all types of events, fans earned, Bond Level, and race rewards are obtained the same as in a normal Career.
 For more information, please check Independent Training from the Career tab under Menu in Help.

 ■ Important Information
 1. You cannot switch to a normal Career during Independent Training.
 2. Only epithets specific to Independent Training can be obtained.
 3. Goal achievement status per scenario will be treated using rules specific to Independent Training. Independent Training will continue even if goals haven't been completed.
 Additionally, you can still enter other race classes even if your trainee does not win her maiden race.
 4. In Independent Training, you cannot acquire trophies from winning races.
 5. In Independent Training, Career events and concerts cannot be viewed.
Because of this, nothing will unlock in the Concert Theater or Gallery.
 6. In Independent Training, missions tied to Career Scenarios, missions with requirements based on statistics that aren't displayed in the Independent Training log, as well as some other missions, will not progress.
 7. Career results will not be finalized until the Independent Training log is displayed. Results that depend on the completion of a Career playthrough, such as events and rewards with a daily limit, will be reflected once the Independent Training log displays for the first time.

label: news
title: Transfer Requests now available!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC), a Transfer Request event has begun!
 Transfer Requests allow trainers to receive rewards by transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the recipient trainer's desired conditions.

 Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 26, 2026 (UTC)

 Outline

 By transferring Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions, you can earn rewards.
 Any transferred Veteran Umamusume will disappear.
 Please be aware that once a Veteran Umamusume has been transferred, it cannot be recovered.
 Requests are updated every two days at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).

 Request Conditions

 Each trainer's request includes required conditions relating to the Veteran Umamusume's abilities and achievements.
 You may only transfer Veteran Umamusume that meet the request conditions.

 Rank

 Each request has a defined rank.
 The higher the rank, the greater rewards you can receive.

 Transfer Availability Period

 Each request has a transfer availability period.
 You can no longer transfer once the availability period has passed.

 Transfer Amount

 The amount of possible transfers per request is limited.
 Transferring one Veteran Umamusume reduces the amount by one transfer.
 Once a request's remaining transfers reach 0, you will be unable to transfer to that trainer.

 Rewards

Your rewards will differ depending on the contents and rank of the request.
 ■ Main Rewards
 • Trainee Umamusume Star Pieces
 • Monies
 • Support Points
 Note: When the reward is a Trainee Umamusume's Star Pieces, you will receive Star Pieces corresponding to the transferred Veteran Umamusume.

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Transfer Requests, please refer to Transfer Requests under Umamusume in Help.
 2. Rewards are added directly to your totals.
 3. Rewards will not include Star Pieces for different outfit versions of the transferred Veteran Umamusume.
 4. The option to select all transfer requests will be changed to Off if the request list is updated due to time elapsing.
 5. The availability period and contents of Transfer Requests are subject to change without warning.

title: The race event Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is here!
message:
As of 10:00 p.m., Jul 15, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Leo Cup has begun!
 Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 15 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 21, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 12 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Jul 15, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Jul 17, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Jul 15 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 17, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Jul 17 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 19 - 9:59 a.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 21, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Nakayama / Turf / 1,200m (Sprint) / Right-Handed / Outer / Summer / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Leo Cup Platinum
 • Leo Cup Gold
 • Leo Cup Silver
 • Leo Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Leo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.
