label: news
title: The league selection period for the Champions Meeting: Leo Cup has begun!
message:
At 10:00 p.m., Jul 15, 2026 (UTC), the Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is set to begin!
 Champions Meeting: Leo Cup is a race event in which you match with other trainers around the world to compete in real time.
   In order to compete, you will need to register a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
 (Champions Meeting is unlocked when you reach a Team Rank of E2.)

 Event Availability Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 15 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 21, 2026 (UTC)

 League Selection Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 12 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC)
 • After 10:00 p.m., Jul 15, 2026 (UTC), it is not possible to change your league selection once you have made it.
 • If you register for the Champions Meeting after 10:00 p.m., Jul 17, 2026 (UTC), you will automatically be entered into Round 2, Group B.
 • If you have not entered the Champions Meeting by 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC), you will not be able to do so after that point.
 

 Round 1

 10:00 p.m., Jul 15 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 17, 2026 (UTC)

 Round 2

 10:00 p.m., Jul 17 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 19, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Registration Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 19 - 9:59 a.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Matching Period

 10:00 a.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 20, 2026 (UTC)

 Final Round: Race Period

 10:00 p.m., Jul 20 - 9:59 p.m., Jul 21, 2026 (UTC)

 Race Conditions

 Nakayama / Turf / 1,200m (Sprint) / Right-Handed / Outer / Summer / Sunny / Firm

 League Selection

 In Champions Meeting events, you can choose to enter either the Graded League or the Open League.
 You will only be matched with other trainers participating in the same league.
 Rewards differ depending on the league you select.

 The two leagues have different conditions for which Veteran Umamusume can enter, so try to select the league best suited for the Career Ranks of the Veteran Umamusume you intend to include in your team.
 Once you have selected a league, you will receive a reward for participation.

 League Details

 • Graded League: All Veteran Umamusume can enter regardless of Career Rank.
 • Open League: Only Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of A+ or below can enter.
 (Please note that Veteran Umamusume with a Career Rank of S or above cannot participate in the Open League.)

 League Participation Rewards

 • Toughness 30 × 3
 • Alarm Clock × 3

 Round Structure

 The Champions Meeting is divided into three rounds: Round 1, Round 2, and the final round.
 Rounds 1 and 2 are preliminaries in which trainers compete to qualify for the later rounds.
 In Round 2 and the final round, trainers are divided into two groups: Group A and Group B.
   The number of races in a single entry, as well as the conditions to progress, depend upon your current round and group.
 The overall round structure is identical for both leagues.

 Round 1 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in Round 2.
 • If you achieve two or fewer wins, you will be assigned to Group B in Round 2.

 Round 2 Details

 • In each entry, you will compete in five races.
 • In each race, you will be matched with two other trainers.
 • Each race features nine contenders.
 • You can make one entry for free each day.
 (Entries after the first require an entry fee of either a Leo Cup Entry Ticket or 30 carats.)
 • You can make up to four entries in total per day.
 Please note that it is possible to enter a Champions Meeting starting from Round 2. In this case, you will automatically be placed in Group B.

 Group A

 • Achieve three wins or more to qualify for Group A in the final round.
 • Achieve one or two wins to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.

 Group B

 • Achieve at least one win to qualify for Group B in the final round.
 • If you achieve no wins, you will not proceed to the final round.
 

 Final Round Details

 • After the registration period and matching period, you will be matched with two other trainers to compete in a single decisive race.
 • The race features nine contenders.
 Please note that the ranking displayed after the race is calculated individually for each player based on their performance throughout the Champions Meeting.

 Final Round Entry

 • All trainers who qualified for the final round are automatically entered for free.
 If you do not register a team for the final round during the registration period, you will automatically be entered using the team from your most recent entry.
 You can change your registered Veteran Umamusume and their strategies until the end of the registration period.

 Event Rewards

 The rewards vary depending on your selected league.
 In the preliminary rounds, you will receive a reward for each entry. The more wins you achieve in that entry, the greater the reward will be.
 In the final round, you will earn rewards based on your league, group, and rank, including event-exclusive titles.

 ■ Event-Exclusive Titles
 • Leo Cup Platinum
 • Leo Cup Gold
 • Leo Cup Silver
 • Leo Cup Bronze

 If you reobtain an event-exclusive title that you have previously obtained, a star will be added to the existing title.
 Applicable titles will be shown with the star upgrade in the in-game reward list.

 Special Missions

 During Rounds 1 and 2, special daily missions will be available, allowing you to earn Leo Cup Entry Tickets!
 As in the previous Champions Meeting, two Entry Tickets are available to claim each day from these missions, so make good use of those additional entries!

 These special missions update each day at 10:00 p.m. (UTC) while Rounds 1 and 2 are in progress. Please take care not to miss out on them.
 (Entry Tickets received from missions are added directly to your totals.)

 Important Information

 1. For more information on Champions Meeting events, please refer to "Champions Meeting" under "Races" in Help.
 2. Entry counts reset daily at 10:00 p.m. (UTC).
 3. Round Rewards and Rank Rewards are added directly to your totals without being sent to your Presents. However, if the current round ends while you are in the middle of an entry, that entry will end immediately and the rewards for any wins will be sent to your Presents.
 4. Any Scout Tickets you possess can be found under Items in the menu.
 5. You cannot include the same Umamusume more than once in a single team.
 6. If it takes too long to find a match, you will instead be matched with other trainers who have previously registered in the same league, group, and round. As such, some races may not take place against other users in real time. In such cases, the opponent's race results will not be affected.
 7. Any remaining Entry Tickets are discarded at the end of Round 2. They cannot be carried over to future Champions Meetings.
 8. The event schedule and contents are subject to change without notice.

label: news
title: Update Announcement
message:
An update was released at 11:00 a.m., Jul 1, 2026 (UTC).

 The details of the update are as follows:

 ■ Feature Updates

 New Features

 • An option to reroll Sparks at the end of a Career.
 • A new Photo Studio mode.
 • The ability to create a Club Card.
 • An option to transfer data using an iCloud backup.

 Updates to the URA Finale Scenario

 Training with Happy Meek


 Happy Meek will now appear as a training partner in this scenario.

 Dueling with Happy Meek


 When Happy Meek appears in training with a special icon, you can face off against her in a duel event after that training session.
 In this event, you can choose one of three contests (one based on the selected training type, and two chosen at random) and pit your trainee against Happy Meek based on a specific attribute or current Energy level.
 Each available contest is displayed with a prediction of the outcome.
 If you win the duel, your trainee will gain attributes, earn skill points, and obtain skill hints based on the chosen contest.
 As you win duels, future duels will increase in level and difficulty, but also offer greater attribute gains and skill point rewards.
 Try to compete with Happy Meek as much as possible to maximize the benefits!
 (Note: There is a limit to how far the level and difficulty of duels with Happy Meek can increase.)

 URA Finale Finals


 If your trainee defeats Happy Meek in enough duels over the course of a Career, Happy Meek will appear in the URA Finale Finals with increased abilities.
 Defeat this stronger Happy Meek to gain more attributes and skill points than normal, along with a new Rare Skill.
 This also increases your chances of obtaining the URA Finale Scenario Spark, and if you have learned any skills from your duels with Happy Meek, the Sparks for these skills will be upgraded into special versions that grant attributes or skill points in addition to skill hints.
 Try to train up a powerful racer who will be able to defeat Happy Meek at her strongest!

 Training


 The attribute values and skill points gained from training in this scenario have been adjusted.

 New Summer Camp Event


 The director will now visit your trainee with refreshments during summer camp in a new Energy-restoring event.

 Endings


 The attribute values and skill points obtained from certain endings have been adjusted.

 Updates to the Unity Cup Scenario

 Extreme Spirit Bursts


 Team members who have already triggered a Spirit Burst can now trigger an additional Extreme Spirit Burst once per Career.
 This special Spirit Burst provides a boost to that team member's attributes and attribute caps.
 What's more, in addition to gaining more from the training session than usual, your trainee can also earn a special skill hint.
 When an Extreme Spirit Burst is available, the failure rate for that training is reduced to 0%, so try to take advantage of them when they appear!

 Elite Teams


 If you fulfill certain conditions during a Career, you'll be able to face off against a special Elite Team.
 Defeating an Elite Team gives your trainee a big boost, so try to make sure your team is up to the task!
 The conditions to face an Elite Team are as follows:
 1. Your team is in the top 10 in the Unity Cup rankings
 2. Your Team Power is A or higher
 3. You have triggered at least one Extreme Spirit Burst

 Upgraded Team Zenith


 If you successfully defeat the Elite Team, Team Zenith will appear in the Unity Cup Finals with increased abilities.
 They won't be easy to defeat, so make sure to train up your whole team as much as possible!
 Defeating this more powerful Team Zenith will contribute greatly to your trainee's growth.
 This also increases your chances of obtaining the Unity Cup Scenario Spark, and if you have learned any Ignited Spirit or Burning Spirit skills, the Sparks for these skills will also be upgraded into special versions that grant attributes or skill points in addition to skill hints.

 New Team Power Rank: S+


 There is now an additional Team Power rank of S+ to achieve after the previous maximum of S.
 Achieving a Team Power of S+ will grant significant gains to your trainee.

 Retrying Unity Cup Races


 If you lose one of the team races that make up the Unity Cup, you will now have the option to consume an item to retry.
 When this option is selected, you can return to before the race and choose a different opposing team if you wish. When retrying, brackets will be reassigned, and the Mood of your aces will be increased by one level for the duration of the race.
 (Reassigned brackets are not guaranteed to be different from previous attempts.)

 Adjustments to Unity Training and Spirit Bursts


 The attribute values and skill points gained from Unity Training and Spirit Bursts have been adjusted.
 Unity Training and Spirit Bursts no longer require training to consume more Energy.
 Skill hints obtained from Spirit Bursts will now be selected from the skills of the team members who triggered them.

 Career Events


 The attribute values and skill points gained from certain Career Events have been adjusted.

 Training


 The attribute values and skill points gained from training in this scenario have been adjusted.

 Updates to Career

 • It is now possible to increase your trainee's attribute caps during a Career.
 (Attribute cap increase is dependent on the selected Career scenario and the outcome of Inspiration events. In addition, all attribute gains in excess of 1,200 will be halved.)
 • The Skip feature has been updated to progress more quickly during Career Events when set to the maximum speed.
 • Adjustments have been made to the text displayed in Career Events when obtaining a hint for a skill that has already been learned.

 Updates to Scouts

 • Added an option to use multiple scout tickets at once on the Scout screen.
 • Adjusted the UI for Make Debut Scouts.
 • Adjusted the conditions for certain animations in Pretty Derby Scouts.

 Updates to Daily Sales

 • Items will now be added to the Daily Sale shop cumulatively each time the conditions to trigger the shop are met. As this makes it unnecessary to close the shop, the button to do so has been removed.
 • Once triggered, the Daily Sale shop will now be available until the next daily reset at 3:00 p.m. (UTC), without the time limit that was previously applied.
 • It is now possible to buy multiple Daily Sale items at once by selecting them using checkboxes. There is also a Select All button to easily buy the entire stock.
[The Daily Sale function update will be applied from 3:00 p.m., July 3, 2026 (UTC).]

 Updates to Existing Features

 • Expanded the Friends feature to allow 10 additional follows.
 • Expanded the Veteran Umamusume list to allow 20 additional saved racers.
 • When viewing Umamusume details, it is now possible to flick or drag to scroll between Umamusume in the current list.
 • Expanded Filter options for Veteran Umamusume to allow filtering by common Sparks.
 ("Common Sparks" refers collectively to Scenario Sparks, race Sparks, and skill Sparks.)
 • Expanded Filter options for Veteran Umamusume to allow filtering by specific Unique Sparks.
 • Expanded Filter options for Support Cards to allow filtering by specific Support Effects.
 • Updated the Race Results screen with a new option to take photos.
 • Updated the Team Trials screen with a new Race History feature.
 (Race history can only be viewed for races that take place after this update.)
 • Updated the Concert Theater with a new feature to save and load concert lineups.
 (To use this feature, select the Presets button on the Concert Theater screen.)
 • Updated the Concert Theater with a new feature to apply costume changes to all performers at once.
 • Updated the Paid Carats Details screen to display a more detailed breakdown of purchased products and carat totals.
 • Expanded the Item Request feature in Clubs to allow the requesting of Winner's Sashes.
 • Updated the Race Events screen to display only events that are currently ongoing, upcoming, or in their reward collection period. Events that are not currently available will not appear.
 • Adjusted the unlock conditions for skill activation voices in Trainer Notes as follows:
 Before: Activate the relevant skill.
 After: Hear the voice line for the skill or raise the Trainee Umamusume to at least 3★.

 New Item

 • Added the new Gallery Key item.
(Gallery Keys will become available to obtain from 10:00 p.m., Jul 2, 2026 (UTC). Some are planned to be distributed as a gift, and they will also be added to the Friend Point Exchange lineup.)

 ■ Important Information
 1. It may take some time for the update to appear in the store.
 2. In addition, the update may fail in some cases due to the accumulation of temporary data on your device.
 If you are unable to update, please turn off your device, wait a minute or two, and then restart your device and update from the store.

label: update
title: A Letter from the Developers
message:
Dear Trainers,
 Today we'd like to share with you a little bit about our plans for the English version of Umamusume: Pretty Derby.
 

Pacing

 First, you can expect to see all the same events and Scouts as in the Japanese version. However, we want you to experience the latest content sooner rather than later, so content will be released at a faster pace, with shorter gaps in between events and Scouts, but the durations of the events and Scouts themselves will be the same as they originally were in the Japanese version.
 

Expedited Features

 Second, the English version will have the following features available on release:
 • Landscape mode in races
 • Jukebox
 We also plan to selectively implement other new features and quality of life changes earlier than in the Japanese version going forward.
 For example, we are already working on the Guided Career feature, which the Japanese version didn't receive until its 4th anniversary. We'll keep you updated on when you can expect to see it in game.
 

Cross-Platform

 Lastly, the English version will feature cross-platform play between mobile and PC. You can use the same account to play on either platform.

 With your input and support, we hope to deliver a player-friendly experience to trainers around the globe. Thank you for your patience, and we'll see you at Tracen Academy.

 The Umamusume: Pretty Derby Team

 • In the Career Scenario "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax," using training items on attributes greater than 1,000 may cause digits to be cut off, resulting in an incorrect value being displayed.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the displayed value; the actual attribute value is calculated correctly.)

 [Update: 11:30 a.m., Apr 1 (UTC)]
 • Part of the mission text for Part 3 of the Special Missions "Tracen Special: Training the Trainer" contains an error.

 Incorrect: Complete a Career playthrough with at least 3 attributes at S rank or better
 Correct: Complete a Career playthrough with at least 2 attributes at S rank or better
 (Please note that this issue is only present in the mission text; completing a Career playthrough with any 2 attributes at S rank or better will result in clearing the mission.)

 [Update: 8:30 a.m., Mar 26 (UTC)]
 • In the Career Scenario "Trackblazer: Start of the Climax," when purchasing certain items from the Pro Shop with the automatic use option enabled, the "Used" badge is displayed in Japanese.

 (For more information on automatic use of training items, please refer to Trackblazer: Start of the Climax under Career in Help.)

 [Update: 8:00 a.m., Feb 18 (UTC)]
 • In the Steam version, if the Agenda is open in the right-hand menu when starting a Recreation minigame, certain icons in the Scheduled Races screen display incorrectly.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the display; Career gameplay outcomes are not affected. If you encounter this issue, you can return the display to normal by re-opening the Agenda after navigating to a different tab.)

 [Update: 11:09 a.m., Jan 30 (UTC)]
 • In the story event "Blossoming Beginnings! New Year's Karuta Showdown," the Event Bonus effect of applicable Support Cards is not displayed correctly, even if they are in the Trainer's possession.

   (Please note that this issue only affects the display; when completing a Career, the Event Bonus effect is correctly applied to the Event Points received.)
 
 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Jan 22 (UTC)]
 • The text regarding the requirements for obtaining the "Super Sprinter" epithet is currently incorrect.

 Incorrect: Win at least 7 graded races of 1,400 meters or less and attain Stamina and Power of 1,200 or higher
 Correct: Win at least 7 graded races of 1,400 meters or less and attain Speed and Power of 1,200 or higher
 *This is only a display issue―the actual requirements for the epithet are correct.

 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Jan 22 (UTC)]
 • In the Steam version's Options menu, the options listed under Main Settings → Screen Orientation →　Graphics Settings do not change the graphics quality as indicated.

 (Currently, selecting the "Standard" and "Basic" options listed in this location instead switches between Windowed and Borderless Fullscreen display modes. To adjust graphics quality, please use the "Standard" and "Basic" options listed under Graphics → Quality on the same page.)

 [Update: 7:00 a.m., Jan 6 (UTC)]
 • An incorrect Umamusume icon displays in Room Matches and the Trophy Room.

 [Update: 6:45 a.m., Dec 26 (UTC)]
 • The parameters that can be gained from an event choice may actually be higher than what's displayed in the pop-up when checking its effects.

 [Update: 8:00 a.m., Dec 17 (UTC)]
 • The Members screen cannot be scrolled when accessed from Invite under the Club menu.

 [Update: 9:00 a.m., Dec 2 (UTC)]
 • In some cases, the Current Promotion Line in Team Trials will display "0 pts".

 (Please note that this issue only affects the number displayed; your actual score is unaffected.)

 [Update: 5:30 a.m., Nov 27 (UTC)]
 • The skill level for Agnes Digital's Unique Skill, "OMG! (ﾟ∀ﾟ) The Final Sprint! ☆", may sometimes not increase during the "Fan Fest" trainee event despite fulfilling the prerequisites.

 [Update: 9:30 a.m., Oct 3 (UTC)]
 • The number of completed missions is not properly displayed on the Missions icon on the Home screen even when there are mission rewards available to collect.

 (Please note that this issue only affects the number displayed on the Missions icon; mission rewards can still be collected by selecting the icon as usual. If you encounter this issue, restarting the game should cause the correct number to appear on the icon.)

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Oct 2 (UTC)]
 • Some errors were included in the Help text for the "Uma Quest: Epic Odyssey" story event.

 (The text has been fixed and any incorrect information has been removed.)

 [Update: 7:20 a.m., Oct 1 (UTC)]
 • On Android devices, an error is displayed repeatedly when starting a new game, after entering the user's country/region and birth date. It is possible to bypass this error and progress the game by selecting the Retry option twice.

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Aug 21 (UTC)]
 • In the 10:00 p.m., Aug 20 (UTC) notice announcing new Spotlight Pretty Derby and Spotlight Support Card Scouts, the rarity of the SR Support Card "[The World's My Oyster] Seeking the Pearl" was incorrectly listed as SSR.

 (This issue was only present in the notice text; scout rates etc. were not affected.)

 [Update: 10:30 a.m., Aug 5 (UTC)]
 • When playing Team Trials on the Steam version of the game, trainers may be unable to proceed past the results screen.

 [Update: 12:40 p.m., Aug 1 (UTC)]
 • When attempting to purchase carats, an error listed with Error Code 102 can occur.

 [Update: 6:00 a.m., Jul 11 (UTC)]
 • The Main Mission "Link App Data" currently cannot be completed in the Steam version.

 • When using certain Android devices (Android 16), the app may not launch properly.

   These issues will be corrected in future updates.
 It may take some time before fixes can be implemented, so we ask for your patience.

 We sincerely apologize to any trainers who are inconvenienced by these issues.

title: Check out "Sakura Bakushin O's BAKUSHIN ADVICE!"
message:
Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin!!!
 Are you a new Umamusume trainer? Are you looking to improve your skills? Then "Sakura Bakushin O's BAKUSHIN ADVICE!" might be just the video series you need!
 

 Overview

 To celebrate the release of Umamusume: Pretty Derby, we've prepared a series of videos to help budding trainers get to grips with how to play the game!
 
 In these videos, Sakura Bakushin O and the other Umamusume will answer all of your pressing questions, explaining in easy-to-understand terms how to go about guiding your trainee!
 
 

 Video Contents

 This video series is made up of 8 episodes in total.
 
 [[[Episode 1: Support Cards]]]
 [[[Episode 2: Choosing Support Cards]]]
 [[[Episode 3: I Don't Want to Fail Training!]]]
 [[[Episode 4: Mood is Key!]]
 [[[Episode 5: Choosing a Race]]]
 [[[Episode 6: Running Style]]]
 [[[Episode 7: Last Spurt and Skills]]]
 [[[Episode 8: Inspiration]]]
 
 

 How to View the Videos

  Check out the videos here!
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLbRq7_wpPI8lplzYnXcq2WIuUMA3-iLwH
 
 We hope you'll take the opportunity to enjoy these special videos and get to grips with training your Umamusume!
 
 All together now, trainers... Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin!!!

title: 3★ and SSR Guaranteed Head Start Scouts now available!
message:

 See below for a rundown of some of the Trainee Umamusume and Support Cards that are available from each!
